name: Legge 23 settembre 2025, n. 132 — Disposizioni e deleghe al Governo in materia di intelligenza artificiale
description: First national comprehensive AI statute enacted by an EU Member State complementing Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (EU AI Act). Establishes sectoral transparency, human-in-the-loop oversight, minor data protection rules, national governance (AgID and ACN), and criminal offences for unlawful AI deepfakes.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by Normattiva (Italian Government Legal Publisher) (normattiva.it) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within Normattiva (Italian Government Legal Publisher) (normattiva.it).
